info.description: The Baggage Information API provides a streamlined way to access details about airline flights and their associated baggage. This endpoint allows users to retrieve information on baggage for specified flights, enabling carriers, travel agencies, and passengers to manage baggage inquiries efficiently. Typical use cases include checking baggage status, understanding baggage allowances, and resolving baggage-related issues. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate comprehensive baggage management functionalities into their applications.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed baggage information associated with their flight bookings, including allowances, restrictions, and additional services.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving baggage information associated with flights. This operation allows the user to query details related to the baggage policies, weight limits, and other relevant information that may affect the traveler's experience concerning their luggage.
